questions.q: The sum of three consecutive numbers is always divisible by ____.
A number is divisible by 3 if ____.
options: the sum of its digits is divisible by 3
questions.explanation: This is the divisibility rule for 3.

questions.q: A number is divisible by 4 if its last two digits form a number divisible by ____.
questions.explanation: 100 is divisible by 4, so only the last two digits matter.

questions.q: What is the sum of an even and an odd number?
What is the sum of the first 6 odd numbers?
questions.explanation: The sum of the first n odd numbers is n², and 6² = 36.
